Reliable Website Care

Professional Website Maintenance Services That Keep Your Site Secure, Updated & Running Smoothly

A website should not be left unattended after it goes live. Outdated plugins, failed updates, broken forms, security vulnerabilities, slow loading pages, and unnoticed technical errors can affect your business, search visibility, and customer experience.

Our website maintenance services provide ongoing technical support to keep your website updated, protected, monitored, and performing properly. From routine website updates and backups to security checks, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring, we help prevent small issues from becoming costly problems.

As a Houston-based website maintenance company serving businesses nationwide, we provide professional support for WordPress and other business websites. That includes WordPress maintenance services for anything from a five-page brochure site to a store with dozens of plugins and integrations.

24/7 Monitoring | Houston-Based Support | No Deposit Required

Website Updates

Core, themes, plugins & technical components

Security & Monitoring

Regular checks to identify potential issues

Backups & Recovery

Restore points to help protect your website data

Expert Support

Real technical help when your website needs attention

Keep My Website Updated

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

What Do Our Website Maintenance Services Include?

Website maintenance is more than occasionally updating a plugin. A professional website care service involves regularly monitoring the technical parts of your website, applying updates safely, checking for errors, maintaining backups, and addressing issues before they affect visitors.

Our website management services can include:

  • WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates
  • Website security checks and malware monitoring
  • Regular website backups and recovery support
  • Broken link and functionality checks
  • Contact form and integration testing
  • Website speed and performance monitoring
  • Plugin and theme compatibility checks
  • SSL and HTTPS issue monitoring
  • Mobile display and layout checks
  • Database and technical troubleshooting
  • Website error diagnosis and repair
  • Ongoing technical support for business websites

Every website has different maintenance needs. A small business website may require regular updates and backups, while an eCommerce, healthcare, or high-traffic website may require more frequent monitoring and technical support.

Our goal is simple: keep your website functioning properly while reducing the risk of unexpected downtime and technical problems.

How We Work

How We Take Over Maintenance of Your Site

01

Free Consultation

We look at your site, its plugins and its hosting, and tell you what needs attention before we take it on.

02

Live Review

On a phone call, Zoom or Google Meet, we walk you through what we found and which plan fits your site.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Initial Cleanup

We fix outstanding problems first, then test forms, checkout and key pages. Most cleanups take 1–3 business days.

05

Ongoing Care

Each month we update, back up, monitor and fix what comes up, and keep you informed about what changed.

Why Ongoing Website Maintenance Matters

Your website relies on multiple components working together. WordPress core files, plugins, themes, hosting, databases, forms, security tools, and third-party integrations can all create problems when they become outdated or incompatible.

Without ongoing website maintenance, a small issue can gradually turn into a larger one. For example, an outdated plugin may create a security vulnerability, a failed update may break a page layout, or an unnoticed form error may prevent potential customers from contacting your business.

Regular business website maintenance helps you stay ahead of these problems.

Professional maintenance can help you:

  • Keep software and website components updated
  • Identify errors before they affect more visitors
  • Reduce the risk of security vulnerabilities
  • Maintain reliable backups for recovery
  • Check that important forms and features continue working
  • Address slow loading and performance issues
  • Maintain compatibility between themes, plugins, and server environments
  • Reduce the need for emergency website repairs

Instead of waiting until your website goes down, becomes infected, or stops generating leads, ongoing maintenance provides a more organized way to manage its technical health.

Your Website Is Working for Your Business Every Day

Customers may visit your website at any time. They may search for your services, submit a contact form, make a purchase, request an appointment, or look for important business information.

If the website is slow, broken, unavailable, or showing security warnings, that experience can affect how customers view your business.

Our website support services help you maintain a website that is ready to support your business day after day.

Website Updates, Backups & Security Maintenance

One of the most important parts of professional website maintenance is managing updates safely.

Updates are necessary for security, compatibility, and functionality, but updating everything without checking compatibility can sometimes create new problems. A plugin update may conflict with your theme, a PHP change may affect older code, or a major platform update may cause parts of your website to stop working.

That is why our approach to website updates focuses on more than simply clicking an update button.

Our maintenance process can include:

Backup Before Major Changes
We create or verify a restore point before significant updates whenever applicable, providing a recovery option if an unexpected issue occurs.

Core, Theme & Plugin Updates
We manage necessary updates while checking for compatibility issues that could affect website functionality.

Functionality Checks
Important areas such as forms, navigation, layouts, login access, and other key website features can be checked after changes.

Security Monitoring
We look for potential security concerns, suspicious activity, malware issues, and vulnerabilities that require attention.

Backup & Recovery Support
If a website experiences a serious technical problem, available backups can play an important role in the recovery process.

SSL & HTTPS Monitoring
Security certificate problems can trigger browser warnings and reduce visitor trust. We can identify and address related technical issues.

Regular maintenance does not guarantee that every technical problem or security incident can be prevented. However, keeping your website updated, monitored, and backed up can significantly improve your ability to identify and respond to problems.

Professional WordPress Maintenance Services for a More Reliable Website

WordPress websites require regular attention because they often rely on multiple plugins, themes, page builders, integrations, and hosting configurations.

Our WordPress maintenance services help businesses manage these moving parts without having to handle every technical update themselves.

We work with common WordPress environments and can help maintain websites using platforms and tools such as:

  • Elementor
  • Divi
  • WPBakery
  • WooCommerce
  • Astra
  • Avada
  • OceanWP
  • Contact form and booking integrations
  • SEO and analytics plugins
  • Security and backup tools

Our WordPress website maintenance can help with:

  • Safe core, plugin, and theme updates
  • Plugin conflict troubleshooting
  • Theme compatibility issues
  • PHP compatibility checks
  • Broken layouts after updates
  • Slow WordPress performance
  • Dashboard and admin issues
  • Database-related technical problems
  • Website backup and recovery support
  • Security and malware-related concerns
  • Broken forms, buttons, or website features

A WordPress website can become difficult to manage when different people repeatedly install plugins, make changes, or update components without a coordinated process. Over time, this can create unnecessary conflicts, duplicate tools, performance issues, and harder-to-diagnose errors.

Our WordPress website maintenance provides a central technical support process to help keep your website organized and functioning properly.

Get WordPress Maintenance Support

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Plans start at $300 per month
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

How to Get Started

Call us at 832-266-7209 or send your details through the form, and we will get back to you promptly.

We then schedule a live website review by phone, Zoom or Google Meet. During that session we:

  • Look through your website, plugins and hosting with you
  • Point out anything that is outdated, broken or at risk
  • Recommend a maintenance plan and explain what it covers
  • Take a full backup before we change anything

If the site needs repairs before regular maintenance can start, we tell you what they are and what they cost first. Repairs follow our pay-after-the-fix approach.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Maintenance Services

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
What are website maintenance services?

Website maintenance services involve ongoing care for a website, including updates, backups, security checks, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical support. The exact services depend on your website and maintenance plan.

How much do website maintenance services cost?

Our maintenance plans start at $300 per month. The price depends on the size of the site, how many plugins and integrations it uses, whether it takes payments, and how much support you need. See Website Maintenance Plans for details.

How often should a WordPress website be maintained?

A WordPress website should be monitored regularly, with updates managed based on security, compatibility, and website requirements. Websites with eCommerce features, frequent traffic, or multiple plugins may require more frequent attention.

What is included in WordPress maintenance services?

WordPress maintenance services can include core, theme, and plugin updates, backups, security monitoring, compatibility checks, error troubleshooting, performance monitoring, and ongoing technical support.

Can you fix problems found during website maintenance?

Yes. If our maintenance checks identify problems such as broken layouts, plugin conflicts, form errors, slow performance, or other technical issues, we can diagnose the cause and recommend or provide the appropriate repair. Additional repair work may depend on the maintenance plan and complexity of the issue.

Why hire a website maintenance company instead of handling updates myself?

A professional website maintenance company provides technical oversight and helps manage updates, backups, security, compatibility, and troubleshooting. This can save business owners time and reduce the risk of making changes that accidentally affect website functionality.

Website Support Services for Businesses That Need Ongoing Technical Help

Not every business needs a full-time web developer, but most businesses still need someone reliable to handle website problems when they arise.

Our website support services are designed for businesses that want professional technical help without managing every issue internally. That can mean regular maintenance, occasional changes, troubleshooting, or someone to coordinate the work of several vendors on one site.

We can help manage issues such as:

  • Broken pages and layouts
  • Plugin and theme problems
  • Contact form errors
  • Website speed concerns
  • Mobile display issues
  • Login and dashboard problems
  • SSL or HTTPS errors
  • Broken links and redirects
  • Website updates
  • Technical SEO issues
  • Security and malware concerns
  • Hosting-related website problems

When an issue appears, the first step should be understanding what caused it. Instead of making unnecessary changes that could create additional problems, we focus on diagnosing the technical issue and determining the appropriate solution.

This approach helps businesses maintain greater control over their websites and avoid repeatedly dealing with the same unresolved problems.

Need help maintaining your website? Get professional support before a small issue turns into major downtime.

Speak With a Website Maintenance Expert

Common Website Problems Our Maintenance Services Help Prevent

A website can appear to be working normally while technical issues develop in the background. Outdated software, failed backups, plugin conflicts, security weaknesses, and broken integrations may not always be noticed immediately.

Our website maintenance services help identify and address common problems that can affect your website’s performance, security, and functionality.

Slow Website Performance

Slow pages can frustrate visitors and affect conversions. We monitor technical issues that may contribute to poor performance, including unnecessary plugins, outdated software, large files, server-related concerns, and inefficient website configurations.

Broken Contact Forms and Features

A contact form, appointment request form, checkout function, or booking tool may stop working without warning. Regular checks help identify important functionality issues before they continue affecting potential customers.

Plugin and Theme Conflicts

WordPress plugins and themes do not always work perfectly together after updates. Our WordPress maintenance services include compatibility checks and troubleshooting when updates cause layout, functionality, or performance problems.

Security and Malware Concerns

Outdated website components can create security risks. We help monitor your website, identify suspicious activity, address malware-related problems, and apply appropriate security measures.

Broken Layouts and Mobile Display Issues

A page that looks correct on desktop may have problems on mobile devices. Updates, code changes, and plugin conflicts can affect banners, buttons, images, menus, and page layouts.

SSL and HTTPS Errors

Expired certificates and HTTPS configuration problems can create browser warnings that discourage visitors from continuing to your website. Technical monitoring helps identify these issues so they can be addressed.

Broken Links, Redirects, and Error Pages

Pages may become unavailable after website changes, migrations, or URL updates. We help identify broken links, redirect issues, and common errors that affect visitors and website navigation.

Website Downtime and Access Problems

A website may become inaccessible because of hosting issues, server errors, database problems, or failed updates. When an issue occurs, our team can investigate the cause and provide technical support for recovery.

Get Website Maintenance Support

What Every Website Maintenance Plan Can Include

Your website maintenance requirements depend on your platform, website size, traffic, functionality, and how frequently changes are made. A simple informational website does not require the same level of support as an eCommerce store, healthcare website, or high-traffic business platform.

Our maintenance plans are built around the level of ongoing support your website needs, and they start at $300 per month. See Website Maintenance Plans for what each plan includes. Local businesses can also see our Houston and Miami maintenance pages.

Core Website Maintenance

A practical option for websites that need regular technical care and routine updates.

This may include:

  • WordPress core updates
  • Plugin and theme updates
  • Regular backup checks
  • Basic security monitoring
  • Website functionality checks
  • Broken link and error monitoring
  • Technical support when issues arise

Advanced Website Maintenance

For businesses with more active websites, multiple integrations, or greater technical requirements.

This can include everything in core maintenance, plus:

  • More frequent website monitoring
  • Performance and speed checks
  • Advanced troubleshooting
  • Plugin and compatibility management
  • Security hardening
  • Mobile functionality checks
  • Priority technical support
  • Assistance with selected website changes

Website Maintenance + SEO Support

For businesses that want to maintain their website while also working on long-term search visibility.

Depending on the scope of service, this may include:

  • Technical SEO monitoring
  • On-page SEO updates
  • Website speed and mobile optimization
  • Broken link and crawl issue checks
  • Metadata and content updates
  • Google Business Profile support
  • Local SEO support
  • Content and website optimization

SEO requirements vary significantly based on your industry, competition, location, number of services, and target markets. For that reason, SEO work should be discussed separately from routine maintenance requirements.

What We Review Before Recommending a Plan

Before recommending the right level of ongoing website maintenance, we consider factors such as:

  • Your website platform
  • Number of pages and features
  • Plugins and third-party integrations
  • How often the website is updated
  • Current technical condition
  • Security and backup requirements
  • Whether the website processes payments or sensitive information
  • Performance and support requirements

You do not need to pay for unnecessary website support. We can review your website’s requirements and recommend the appropriate level of care.

Website Management Services for Businesses With Multiple Teams

Website problems often develop when several people make independent changes without a central maintenance process.

A social media team may install a tracking tool. An SEO provider may add multiple optimization plugins. A marketing employee may create a new popup. A developer may modify the theme. Another team member may update a plugin without checking how it affects existing functionality.

Over time, these individual changes can create:

  • Duplicate or unnecessary plugins
  • Plugin and theme conflicts
  • Slower website performance
  • Broken layouts
  • Tracking errors
  • Security concerns
  • Difficult troubleshooting
  • Unclear responsibility when something goes wrong

Professional website management services provide a more organized approach.

Rather than allowing every technical change to happen independently, a central website maintenance process helps track updates, review changes, identify conflicts, and maintain greater control over the website’s technical environment.

A Coordinated Maintenance Approach Can Help:

Reduce Unnecessary Changes
Every new plugin, script, or integration adds another component that must be managed.

Identify Compatibility Problems
Changes can be reviewed for potential conflicts with existing themes, plugins, and functionality.

Maintain Website Performance
Removing unnecessary technical clutter and monitoring website components can help support a more stable environment.

Create Clearer Technical Oversight
When a problem occurs, there is a more organized process for reviewing what changed and identifying the likely cause.

This is especially useful for businesses where the website is regularly accessed by internal staff, marketing agencies, developers, SEO teams, and other outside providers.

Business Website Maintenance for Different Industries

Different businesses depend on their websites in different ways. An online store has different technical priorities from a medical practice, law firm, corporate website, or local service business.

Our business website maintenance and website care service can be adapted based on how your website supports your operations.

eCommerce Website Maintenance

For online stores, website problems can directly affect sales. A broken checkout, payment issue, unavailable product page, or slow website can interrupt the customer journey.

Support may include:

  • WooCommerce and platform update management
  • Product and website functionality checks
  • Checkout and form testing
  • Plugin compatibility monitoring
  • Website performance checks
  • Security and backup support

Healthcare Website Maintenance

Healthcare websites often depend on reliable contact, appointment, and service information. Broken forms, outdated provider information, technical errors, or website downtime can affect how patients access your practice online.

Support can include:

  • WordPress website maintenance
  • Secure website update practices
  • Contact and appointment form checks
  • Mobile and speed monitoring
  • Backup and security support
  • Technical website and SEO maintenance

Professional Service Website Maintenance

Law firms, consultants, agencies, and other professional businesses rely on their websites to generate leads and build trust.

We can help maintain:

  • Contact forms and lead-generation features
  • Service page functionality
  • Website updates
  • Mobile display
  • Technical performance
  • Security and backup systems

Small Business Website Maintenance

Small business owners often do not have time to monitor every update, plugin, error, or technical warning.

Our website support services provide an external technical resource to help keep the website updated and address problems when professional assistance is needed.

Security Monitoring, Backups & Website Protection

Security should be an ongoing part of website maintenance, not something considered only after a website has been compromised.

Websites can face risks from outdated software, vulnerable plugins, weak configurations, malicious code, unauthorized changes, and other technical security concerns.

Our maintenance process can include ongoing attention to important areas of website protection.

Security-Focused Maintenance May Include:

  • Monitoring for suspicious website activity
  • Identifying outdated plugins and themes
  • Applying appropriate security updates
  • Malware-related troubleshooting and cleanup support
  • Website backup monitoring
  • Security configuration reviews
  • SSL and HTTPS issue checks
  • Technical support following security incidents

Backups Are Part of Your Recovery Plan

A backup can provide an important recovery option when a website experiences serious problems.

Before significant changes, updates, or technical work, we follow appropriate backup procedures based on the website’s existing environment and service arrangement. This helps reduce the risk associated with unexpected update failures or technical changes.

However, backup systems should also be checked regularly. A backup that has never been reviewed or tested may not provide the recovery support a business expects during an emergency.

Website Security Requires Ongoing Attention

No website can be guaranteed completely immune from every cyber threat or technical failure. However, regular updates, active monitoring, appropriate backups, and prompt attention to security issues can help reduce avoidable risks.

Our website maintenance company helps businesses take a more proactive approach to website care instead of waiting until a serious issue forces an emergency repair.

Stop Worrying About Website Updates and Technical Problems

Your website needs regular care to remain secure, functional, and ready for your customers. From website updates and backups to security monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing technical support, our professional website maintenance services help keep your site running smoothly.

For a WordPress site or any other business website, we can review it and recommend the level of business website maintenance it actually needs.

Talk with our website maintenance team today to discuss your site, identify its support needs, and get professional help with ongoing website care.

Speak With a Website Expert — (832) 266-7209

Is Your Website Getting the Maintenance It Needs to Stay Secure and Reliable?

Let our team handle your website updates, backups, security checks, and ongoing technical support so you can focus on running your business.

Let's Have A Free Consultation

Call or text us — we’ll review your website live and give you a clear plan and a free, no-obligation quote.
